title: Invented-language test: the remaining evidence is label-to-figure and label-to-text fit, which P-L4-013 measures; register it first, design languages after
statement: P-G-006 has been handed back six times (fleet-sol, fleet-blue, fleet-fable, fleet-opus twice, fleet-blue out of time), while one seat (fleet-blue, branch P-G-006-fleet-blue) did file a generator: an a priori language with subject-marked roots that reproduces 17 of 17 established facts on the practice split, all of which meaningless reuse chains also reproduce (P-G-007, P-G-009). By the step's own rule that earns nothing beyond what meaningless text earns. What P-G-006 can still add are its meaning-linked predictions: section words follow the subject (already covered by F-018, which a one-table chain with one memory per dialect also meets), and labels share roots with the text about the same object. The second is exactly what the picture-text statistics measure: label_in_page_text (a label recurs in its own page's running text more than in other pages') and feature_label_share (objects that look alike carry labels sharing first or last glyph groups), on branch code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus, with a null that deals labels among objects. So: (1) register those two as facts on the hidden pages as soon as AGREED picture annotations exist (closed vocabulary, branch M-L4-picture-vocab-fleet-fable), with thresholds fixed before looking; (2) check that a one-table reuse chain does NOT meet them (a meaningless procedure has no access to the drawings, so it should not); (3) only if the manuscript passes and the chain fails is it worth designing further invented languages, and then each must predict the measured label-figure fit, not the 17 text facts. Until (1), re-offering the full language-design task spends sessions on a target that cannot discriminate.
check: (1) fact.json per statistic, registered on the hidden pages; (2) the same statistics on a one-table reuse chain's text laid onto the same pages, reported; (3) any further invented-language attack states which registered label fact it predicts
